Swap the Fuel [ref] / PipelineType [ref] (currently a generic 2025-06-06 Xinhua 'Guangxi achieves city-to-city gas connectivity' article that never mentions this pipeline by name) for one of the row-specific approval docs below, which explicitly describe a natural-gas branch transmission pipeline with distribution stations/valve chambers.
validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed by THREE independent, row-specific official sources spanning three separate government actions/agencies: (1) Guangxi Development & Reform Commission project approval dated 2019-12-29 / published 2020-01-08 (project code 2019-451300-57-02-005045), (2) a RE-approval of the same project dated 2022-08-23 (the first approval's own text states a 2-year validity window that lapses automatically if construction hasn't started — this is why a second approval exists), and (3) a Guangxi Dept. of Natural Resources land-use pre-review ledger entry dated 2023-12-07 that names this exact segment '广西天然气支线管网项目来宾天然气支线管道工程（武宣-象州-金秀段）' verbatim with a 0.6467 ha pre-review parcel. All three name the segment by its full Chinese title matching the sheet's segment name exactly (Wuxuan-Xiangzhou-Jinxiu). This is NOT a GEM-only entity.

SPEC — all confirmed against the 2020 and 2022 approval texts, which independently repeat identical numbers two years apart: Length 148 km (source: '新建约148km' / '管道线路全长148公里') = GEM 148.00 EXACT. Diameter 273.1mm (source: 'D273.1mm' / '管径273.1毫米') = GEM 273.10 EXACT. Pressure 4.0 MPa (source: '设计压力为4.0MPa') = GEM 4.00 EXACT. Capacity: source states '设计输量为1.87×10^8 Nm3/a' / '设计输气能力1.87亿立方米/年' = 0.187 bcm/y, which rounds correctly to GEM's 0.19 bcm/y. Route: source states the pipeline runs from Xingbin District through Wuxuan County and Xiangzhou County to Jinxiu (Yao Autonomous) County, all within Laibin — matches GEM StartLocation 'Xingbin District' / EndLocation 'Jinxiu Yao Autonomous County', both StartPrefecture/EndPrefecture 'Laibin'. SegmentCost: source states total investment '约47874.47万元' = RMB 478,744,700, vs GEM's RMB 478,755,700 — a negligible RMB 11,000 (0.002%) discrepancy, not material, not flagged as an error.

ATTRIBUTION: Operator (QCCOwner) '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' and Owner1 'Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd' both match the source's '项目单位:广西广投天然气管网有限公司' EXACTLY in both the 2020 and 2022 approval texts. However, the Fuel [ref] and PipelineType [ref] currently cite http://www.gx.xinhuanet.com/20250606/032105f0711e4633a1f26693d3eba852/c.html — I read the full article (bypassing a cert mismatch via direct fetch) and it is a GENERIC 2025-06-06 Xinhua piece celebrating Guangxi's province-wide gas-network 'city-to-city' (市市通) milestone via a DIFFERENT pipeline (Nanning-Pingxiang/Nanning-Chongzuo section); it gives network-wide aggregate stats (5,203.9 km operated, 33 bcm/y capacity, 14 prefectures) but never names Laibin, Wuxuan, Xiangzhou, or Jinxiu. It does not itself support this specific row, even though the Fuel=Gas / PipelineType=transmission VALUES are almost certainly correct (a 273.1mm/4.0MPa branch line feeding county distribution stations is textbook transmission-class gas pipeline). Recommend re-pointing those two refs to the approval documents below, which do name this pipeline directly.

CLASSIFICATION: correctly classified as a gas transmission branch pipeline (not gathering/process) — the source explicitly describes 3 new distribution/gas-transfer stations (分输站) and 4 valve chambers along a 148 km branch trunk, consistent with GGIT transmission convention.

DUPLICATE: checked against all 42 other in-scope Guangxi rows in the roster — no other row's route/name plausibly matches this Laibin/Wuxuan/Xiangzhou/Jinxiu corridor. Not a duplicate.

TOOL NOTE: url_verifier.py gives a false-negative FAIL on the two dnr.gxzf.gov.cn Wayback URls used here — I confirmed via direct `requests` inspection that the tool's HTTP client auto-detects ISO-8859-1 encoding for these particular archive.org-proxied pages (no charset in the response header), corrupting the Chinese text used for its substring check, even though a plain UTF-8-decoded fetch (curl) shows the exact segment name present multiple times. This is a documented class of verifier false negative (encoding artifact), not evidence the pages are wrong or fake; I read the full decoded text of both pages myself before citing them.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Traced a full permitting timeline, all row-specific (not aggregate): approved 2019-12-29/pub. 2020-01-08 (2-yr validity) -> lapsed -> RE-approved 2022-08-23 (again 2-yr validity, itself stating unbuilt-and-unextended approvals 'automatically lapse') -> land-use pre-review (选址意见书) renewed 2023-12-07 for this exact segment name, per a Guangxi Dept. of Natural Resources approval ledger. Searched extensively (Chinese-language) for any 2024-2026 evidence of actual construction start (开工/施工/招标) specific to the Wuxuan-Xiangzhou-Jinxiu segment and found none. However, I found a 2025-01-03-published land REQUISITION approval (建设用地批复, a later/firmer step than pre-review) for '来宾天然气支线管道工程（兴宾—武宣段）（兴宾段）' — same base project name ('来宾天然气支线管道工程'), same municipality/company family, covering the Xingbin-district portion of what the 2020/2022 approvals describe as one continuous route from Xingbin through Wuxuan/Xiangzhou to Jinxiu. I judge this most likely to be a piecemeal land-acquisition tranche of the SAME overall pipeline (Chinese pipeline land acquisition is routinely split into named sub-segments/parcels along one approved route), rather than a wholly separate project — but I could not find a standalone project-approval (核准) instrument for '兴宾-武宣段' alone to prove that with certainty, so flagging the inference explicitly for a human to weigh. Taking it at face value, last evidence of forward administrative progress is 2025-01 (~18 months before this review), which is under the sweep's 2-year proposed-dormancy threshold, so 'proposed' stands confirmed rather than triggering the staleness rule. If a reviewer concludes the Jan-2025 land doc is NOT the same segment, the more conservative last-confirmed-progress date for this exact segment name is 2023-12 (~2.6 years ago), which WOULD cross the 2-year threshold — in that case this should be revisited as a 'stale -> shelved' candidate. Recommend a human spot-check of Laibin/Guangxi Guangtou news in Chinese every 6-12 months given this ambiguity.

summary: P4729 (Laibin Wuxuan-Xiangzhou-Jinxiu gas branch, 148km/273.1mm/proposed) is a real, well-documented project (2020 approval -> 2022 re-approval -> 2023 land pre-review, all row-specific) with every spec field (length, diameter, pressure, capacity, route, owner/operator) confirmed exact or near-exact; only caveat is the Fuel/PipelineType ref is a generic network-wide article that doesn't name this pipeline (better refs proposed). Status 'proposed' is confirmed current as of evidence through Jan 2025, though the chain of evidence for this specific segment (vs. a plausibly-related adjacent land parcel) has enough ambiguity that a stale/shelved review in 6-12 months is warranted if no fresher news surfaces.
